subject: Mutual Action Plan: Orchid Diagnostics evaluation — kickoff & timeline
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@orchiddx.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@orchiddx.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Orchid Diagnostics evaluation — kickoff & timeline

Hi Ava / Tom —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a concise mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align stakeholders, validation criteria, and a target close window. High-level ask: confirm goals below and the proposed timeline so we can lock a short cadence.

Top-level goals (please confirm or edit):
- Proof-of-concept: integrate Redwood API with Orchid’s R&D pipeline for 2 model-driven assays
- Latency & cost targets: sub-200ms p50 for inference at test load and cost <$0.04/token equivalent in evaluation mode
- Security: review VPC/private deployment requirements and SOC2 evidence

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- Week 0 (this week): stakeholder kickoff + access requests
- Week 1–2: integration & smoke tests
- Week 3–4: evaluation with representative data sets, quality review
- Target decision point: by week 6 (aiming for Aug 15)

Roles I have in mind:
- Champion: Ava Collins — product lead / primary approver
- Technical reviewer: Priya Narang — CTO / integration lead (please confirm)
- AE: me (Karthik) — commercial & timeline owner
- CSM: Neha Kapoor — onboarding & success plan owner
I attached a draft MAP spreadsheet (mutual_action_plan_draft.xlsx) with milestones and asks. Link to a living copy is here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-orchid-map

Can you confirm the objectives and who from your side should be at a 30-minute kickoff this week? I’m available Tue/Wed 10–12 PT. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Best,

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0129

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Orchid Diagnostics evaluation — kickoff & timeline

Karthik —

Thanks for pulling this together. The goals look right to me. Confirming roles: I’ll be the champion and Priya will be the technical reviewer (CC’d). Tom is on procurement and will need visibility on the evaluation constraints and any early pricing/usage estimates.

Timeline is reasonable; Aug 15 decision target fits our internal Q3 planning, but can flex if we find more testing time is needed.

I’m available Wed 22 Jul 11:00–11:30 PT or Thu 23 Jul 09:00–09:30 PT for a kickoff — Wed at 11 is best. Please include a short agenda and the checklist of what exact data/access you need from our side (SFTP credentials, sample dataset size, test account permissions, etc.).

Quick note: compliance will ask for a SOC2 + network diagram; happy to get that started after kickoff.

– Ava

ava.collins@orchiddx.com
